info.title: Fenergo Nebula Event Ingress
info.description:
## Purpose of the API

The purpose of the Event Ingress API is to is to provide an endpoint for third party applications to send events to, which will allow Fen-X to process entity related events.

Processing of an event will trigger the correspondent journey depending on the event type and sub type received.
